_comment: Soil texture reference values. fc = field capacity (% vol), wp = wilting point (% vol), sat = saturation (% vol), awc = available water capacity per metre (% vol), infil = typical infiltration (mm/hr). Reference estimates from standard soil-physics ranges — NOT measurements of the farmer's field.

sandy.label: Sandy
sandy.note: Drains quickly, low nutrient holding — favour drip, frequent small irrigations.

loamy.label: Loamy
loamy.note: Balanced structure — good for most crops and irrigation methods.

clay.label: Clay
clay.note: High retention, poor drainage — waterlogging and leaching risk if over-irrigated.

sandy_loam.label: Sandy Loam
sandy_loam.note: Leaches nutrients faster than loam — avoid large single irrigations.

clay_loam.label: Clay Loam
clay_loam.note: Retains well — watch for waterlogging after heavy rain.

other.label: Other / unknown
other.note: Treated with loam-like defaults while the soil type is unknown.
